pages.title: Compactor Upgrade
pages.text: Drop one into a Terminal's upgrade row and every slot in that Terminal's pool can hold 32 more of an item past its normal stack limit. Stacks with itself - up to 3 in the upgrade row at once, for up to +96 per slot.

pages.title: Slot Upgrade
pages.text: Adds 1 extra slot to the pool per upgrade installed. Unlike a Living Chest's slots, this storage lives inside the Terminal itself - removing the upgrade later drops whatever was sitting in that slot.

pages.title: Mixing Both
pages.text: The upgrade row holds 3 slots total, and Stack and Slot Upgrades can be mixed freely across them - there's no requirement to commit to one type.
